pages.title: All Conditions Match
pages.text: Every condition in a trigger must pass. Use target self for the skill owner, or target target for the event target. Action conditions use the entity selected for that action as their target.

pages.title: Health Fractions
pages.text: Choose health, target target, unit fraction, and max 0.3 to trigger against a victim at or below 30% health. Use target self for the player. Fractions always compare against that entity maximum health.

pages.title: Health Points
pages.text: Choose unit points for exact health. Ten points are five hearts. A min of 4 and max of 10 admits that inclusive range. Remove a bound with Reset when only the other bound is needed. After-hit health is used for hit and hurt checks.

pages.title: Keyword Presence
pages.text: Choose keyword, its definition ID, target, and min stacks. min 1 requires an existing application; min 0 with max 0 requires its absence. Both bounds are inclusive. Combine health and keyword checks to specialize a proc.

pages.title: An Interaction
pages.text: To require scorch before a lightning effect, add a keyword condition to the lightning action, select mastery:scorch, and use min 1. Follow with remove_keyword if the interaction consumes scorch. These are ordinary script fields, with no Java required.
